Tiger Reserves in MP and Pilibhit Close for Monsoon Season

Tiger reserves in Madhya Pradesh and the Pilibhit Tiger Reserve will close for visitors starting June 30th and will remain shut until September 30th. This annual closure is implemented during the monsoon season. The closures are a standard practice to protect wildlife and allow natural breeding processes to occur undisturbed.
